input.question: Where do I find my other workspace?
input.answer:
You can find your available workspaces by navigating to your **Account** settings.

Depending on how you use TableCards, your "other" workspace is likely one of these two:

*   **Your Private Workspace:** This is automatically created when you first sign in with Google.
*   **A Studio Workspace:** If you are part of a team, you must join a Studio workspace using an invitation link provided by the team owner or admin.

Keep in mind that projects are tied to the specific workspace they were saved in. If you switch workspaces, you won't see your previous projects until you switch back to the workspace where they were originally created.
expectedBehavior: Answer or offer a registered customer-clicked route; do not navigate or create a case automatically.

Displayed offer prices describe launch hypotheses; checkout is a labelled simulation, not a real payment or paid subscription. Do not call mock access paid access. Exports are digital PDFs. Customers arrange printing themselves. Use actual size / 100%, not Fit to page. Use the separate print-test PDF and check its calibration square before a full event. Normal exports contain card sheets only, without a calibration page. Paper size and printer margins must match the selected layout. TableCards cannot guarantee compatibility with a specific printer or print shop. Preview every card, names and table labels before exporting. Longer names may use up to two balanced lines; names are not silently truncated. Latin accented names, including Vietnamese, are supported; unsupported scripts, remaining unsupported combining marks or impossible text fits fail explicitly before export. Do not claim every language/script works. A server event saying PDF made available does not prove it was downloaded, saved to a device or printed. If a customer reports a missing PDF, ask what they see and their browser/device as needed; never ask for a complete private guest list. Use only permitted reported outcomes, not product database reads.

Customers can paste one name per line or a tabular grid, or import CSV/XLSX. Map guest name, optional table and optional short marker columns. Confirm whether the first row contains headings. Import does not intentionally merge, sort or silently drop guests. Review the imported rows and final preview; suggest a small synthetic example when diagnosing formatting. Never request a private guest list. Saving requires a signed-in selected workspace. Unsaved changes are protected during normal navigation/sign-in; do not promise recovery after the documented draft storage expires or across unrelated browsers/devices. Saved projects belong to the workspace selected when they were saved. Switching to a different workspace does not move the project. Projects provides active and archived views; restore puts an archived project back into active work. Archive is not deletion. Make a copy is the existing professional-plan duplication action. A copied project is a distinct project, and active-project limits still apply. Support/helper cannot copy, restore, delete, export or modify projects on the customer's behalf.

Event Pass $5 one time, one event up to 500 cards, full premium predefined designs, event-only uploaded artwork and two AI batches. Planner Pro $9/month, up to 25 active projects, reusable custom presets, copying and ten monthly AI batches. Studio $19/month, up to five members, 100 active shared projects, shared presets and thirty shared monthly AI batches. Monthly batches do not roll over. Annual plans, per-seat charges and automatic email-domain joining are not offered. The current no-charge preview does not collect payment. Launch Event Pass event binding/90-day edit lifetime, real billing renewal/cancellation and commercial retention boundaries are later Payments work, not verified behavior of the preview. Free does not produce a partial PDF from an over-limit guest list: reduce the list or choose an appropriate offer. Current account access and remaining units must come from verified BFF context, not browser claims or guessed email matches. If account context is missing or stale, explain the uncertainty and direct the customer to Account. Neither helper nor support bot may grant units, override access, refund money or change accounts. A failed AI generation already releases its reserved unit; do not promise a second credit restoration.

Designs are curated templates, not a freeform editor. Paid-offer definitions include a predefined premium library. Custom artwork is PNG/JPEG, fixed 7:4 face ratio, at least 1050 by 600 pixels, at most two megapixels and 10 MiB; PNG color must be eight-bit or lower, and animated/rotated images are unsupported. Customers can adjust supported guest-name font, size, color and position, then preview before export. Event Pass artwork belongs to its event; professional offers can save reusable presets. One AI batch produces four choices. A PNG/JPEG company icon or style image is optional inspiration; it does not guarantee exact logo reproduction. Guest names/list data are not automatically sent to the image provider. AI may be disabled, capped or fail; predefined designs and deterministic export remain available. Do not ask the customer to buy more credits to bypass a provider cap. Generated results and uploaded artwork are workspace-private. Customer follow-up is by email, with no customer ticket-history or reply portal. A fixed receipt acknowledges intake, not identity verification or resolution. Permitted scoped reads and assigned skill loading do not require extra approval. Internal operator notes are not automatically bot context. Email matching is not account authority; private facts require current verified association and eligible recipient. Respect requests for a person. input.question: Does the AI keep an uploaded logo exactly?
input.answer: No, the AI does not guarantee an exact reproduction of an uploaded logo. When you provide a PNG or JPEG company icon, the AI uses it as inspiration for the background generation rather than attempting to recreate the logo perfectly.

input.question: איך זה עובד?
input.answer:
TableCards מאפשרת לך ליצור כרטיסי מקום (place cards) ולהוריד אותם כקובצי PDF מוכנים להדפסה.

חשוב להדגיש: אנחנו מספקים **קבצים דיגיטליים בלבד**. השירות אינו כולל הדפסה, אספקת נייר או משלוחים פיזיים.

**כך זה עובד:**
1. **צפייה וייבוא:** ניתן לייבא נתונים ולצפות בתצוגה מקדימה (Preview) ללא צורך בהתחברות.
2. **עיצוב ושמירה:** כדי להשתמש ברקעים מבוססי בינה מלאכותית (AI backgrounds), לשמור את העבודה או לייצא את הקבצים הסופיים, עליך להתחבר באמצעות **חשבון Google** בלבד.
3. **מצב השירות:** כרגע אנחנו מציעים תצוגה מקדימה ללא עלות (no-charge preview).

האם תרצה עזרה בתחילת התהליך?
expectedBehavior: Answer in natural everyday Hebrew: explain creating printable place cards, adding guest names, choosing a design, previewing and downloading a PDF to print independently.
Keep the overview short and useful; distinguish public preview from Google sign-in for saving/exporting if needed, without dumping unrelated pricing, support or authentication policy.
Do not mix Arabic words or garbled literal translations into Hebrew. Product names, PDF and quoted English UI labels may remain unchanged.

input.question: How can I check print size before doing all cards?
input.answer:
To check your print size before printing your entire guest list, use the separate **print-test PDF**. This file includes a calibration square that you can use to verify the dimensions are accurate.

When you are ready to print, please ensure your printer settings are set to **Actual Size** or **100%** scaling, rather than "Fit to page," to make sure the cards are the correct size.
expectedBehavior: Separate print-test PDF and actual-size setting.

input.question: What can I do before signing in?
input.answer:
Before signing in, you can:

* **Import guest lists:** You can paste names or upload CSV/XLSX files.
* **Preview designs:** You can explore and preview place cards.
* **Explore the landing page:** You can view product examples, pricing, and the FAQ.
* **Ask general questions:** You can get help with general Q&A without an account.

You will need to sign in with Google when you are ready to **save your projects**, **export your cards as PDFs**, or use **AI backgrounds**.

input.question: How do I ignore the headings in an Excel file?
input.answer:
When you import an Excel (XLSX) or CSV file, you will be asked to confirm whether the first row of your file contains headings. 

If you select that row one has headings, TableCards will use those labels to help you map your columns (Guest Name, Table, etc.) instead of importing the header text as a guest name.

input.question: Customer: Cards look too small after printing with scaling enabled.
input.answer:
